description: This Java source file defines a RecyclerView Adapter (JobsAdapter) and ViewHolder (JobsHolder) for displaying a list of job items in an Android application. It manages binding job data to the UI, handling list item clicks to navigate to detailed job activity, and provides utility for sanitizing input strings.

classes.name: JobsAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for binding job data to RecyclerView items, managing creation and binding of view holders.

classes.name: JobsHolder
classes.description: RecyclerView ViewHolder class that represents individual job item views and handles click events to launch detailed activity.

methods.name: JobsAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with a list of jobs.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates new view holders by inflating the list item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds job data to the view holder by setting texts and identifiers.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of job items.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Utility method to replace null or 'null' string inputs with empty strings.

methods.name: JobsHolder
methods.description: ViewHolder subclass for holding references to the job item views and handling click events.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events on list items to start the JobsActivityExtended with relevant extras.
